https://armenopole.com/yp-talks-i-what-h: AGBU YP Lebanon hosts a special YP Talks for the UN Day of Commemoration of Genocide Victims. Journalist Arwa Damon and surgeon Dr. Ghassan Abou Sitta share frontline humanitarian stories that reveal the human lives behind headlines and statistics.
https://armenopole.com/new-collaboration: In collaboration with the Golden Apricot Yerevan International Film Festival, the Armenian Film Society presents three award-winning shorts from the 2026 edition: “Relic” by Sona Khachatryan, “Together Alone” by Artur Sahakyan, and “Dialogues solitaires” by Serouj Hovsepian. An online Q&A with the filmmakers, moderated by Nare Leone Ter-Gabrielyan, follows the screenings.
https://armenopole.com/masterclass-how-t: Masterclass: How to make an award-winning poetry film. Followed by drinks in the bar. Led by director and writer Garo Berberian, poetry producer Tatevik Ayvazyan of Rebel Republic Films and poet Ben Hodgson, creators of the arthouse poetry film Taniel, which screened at multiple festivals winning 20 awards globally. The film is narrated by Sean Bean in English and in Western Armenian, the language of the poet Taniel Varoujan. In this masterclass, they will discuss their experience making a deeply layered film in two languages, approaching the subject of the Armenian Genocide through poetry and arthouse cinematography. Taniel (20 mins) will be screened as part of the masterclass.
https://armenopole.com/back-to-mesrobian: Mesrobian School alumni gather for a reunion evening organized by the alumni association. The event features a cultural program, cheese and wine in a warm, nostalgic atmosphere.
https://armenopole.com/rbrav55v.html: The “Rays of Light” concert is organized by the Hamazkayin Regional Council in Lebanon under the patronage of Catholicos Raphael Bedros XXI Minassian. The Hamazkayin Choir, conducted by Maestro Grigore Allozeanu, will perform with soprano Shoghik Torosyan and pianist Gavin Yusufi.
https://armenopole.com/christmas-market-: An Armenian Christmas bazaar offers traditional items from food to decorations in a festive atmosphere.
https://armenopole.com/hovhannes-davtyan: Stand-up comedian Hovhannes Davtyan brings his ImProViz Show to the Lochem theatre. The energetic performance blends sharp jokes, unexpected twists, and lightning-fast improvisation on current topics. A unique night of direct, lively comedy in an intimate setting.
https://armenopole.com/hw3qkl8n.html: Artist Laureen Topalian presents her art book « Arménie. Le voyage fantasmé » at Armen'livres. The volume gathers nearly 300 drawings and watercolors from her 2011 trip, blending travel journal, historical research into her family origins as survivors of the 1915 genocide, and reinterpretation of historic artworks.
https://armenopole.com/armenian-food-mus: The Armenian Food & Music Festival takes place at St. Mary Armenian Church in Florida. The event features Armenian cuisine, live music, children's activities, and vendor booths.
https://armenopole.com/meruzhan-khachatr: Meruzhan Khachatryan's personal exhibition "Armenian Art - Timeless Heritage" showcases the Armenian artist's works in Massachusetts.
https://armenopole.com/la-cuisine-des-ar: At the Salon du Livre of the Mairie du XVIe, Corinne and Richard Zarzavatdjian present “La Cuisine des Arméniens”, prefaced by Pascal Ory. The book gathers 70 recipes from the global Armenian diaspora, blending travelogue and family heritage.
https://armenopole.com/preservation-du-p: An international colloquium addresses the preservation of Armenian cultural and religious heritage in Artsakh. Participants include academic Patrick Donabédian, MEP Marina Mesure, and historian Lernik Ovanisyan, former Artsakh Culture Minister.
https://armenopole.com/deuxieme-edition-: The 2nd AYK Armenian Film Festival, organized by the CNMA, takes place across 7 cities in Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. Meyzieu screenings include "Marc Nichanian Declassified," six short films, and a double feature with director Alexandra Routhiau-Mikaélian.
https://armenopole.com/les-nuits-armenie: “Les Yeux de Lousanouch” is a historical, musical and cinematic tale staged for the Nuits Arméniennes. The company Colecti Trange Miroir blends projections, immersive headphone audio and live under-camera animation. Marie Arlais and Erwan Fauchard recount Lousanouch’s journey from the Ottoman Empire to Privas.
https://armenopole.com/a-ribbon-of-film-: The "A Ribbon of Film" programme screens five Western Armenian short films, including UK premieres of Arshile Egoyan's "Before They Joined Us" and Anahid Yahjian's "Domestic Demon". A discussion with the filmmakers and Shogher Margossian (Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation), moderated by Tatevik Ayvazyan, follows the screening.
https://armenopole.com/soar-teen-christm: SOAR hosts a teen Christmas party at the Armenian Cultural Centre in Ontario. The 15+ event features music, dancing, food and fun in a festive atmosphere. All proceeds support Christmas gifts and celebrations for children served by SOAR.
https://armenopole.com/free-armenian-xma: The AAA hosts a free shared buffet celebrating Armenian Christmas on 6 January 2027. Attendees bring dishes to share in a spirit of generosity and community friendship.
https://armenopole.com/journee-d-etude-p: Organisation Terre et Culture hosts a study day on Armenians in contemporary Turkey, their identities and heritage. Researchers and specialists will give several lectures exploring their current experiences and forms of belonging.
https://armenopole.com/2mtpqsb9.html: The 21st Armen’Livres Armenian book fair takes place at the Maison de la Culture Arménienne d’Alfortville. The exhibition “La photographie, un regard arménien” brings together around ten photographers for photography’s bicentennial. Highlights include a musical evening with GOUSSAN, literary talks and signings with about ten authors.
https://armenopole.com/forum-europeen-de: The second European Forum of Armenian Youth gathers students, entrepreneurs, and artists from the diaspora in Île-de-France. Organised by the G2IA association, the event features interactive workshops, networking, and talks by young leaders. Political, economic, and cultural figures, including the 16th arrondissement town hall and the Embassy of Armenia in France, are taking part.
https://armenopole.com/armenie-le-voyage: Artist Laureen Topalian presents her art book "Arménie. Le voyage fantasmé" at Armen'livres. The volume gathers nearly 300 drawings and watercolors from her 2011 trip, blending travelogue, historical research into her family roots as survivors of the 1915 genocide, and reinterpretation of vintage artworks.
https://armenopole.com/le-bruit-de-la-ne: Virginie Komaniecki performs “Le bruit de la neige”, a free storytelling show blending Eastern European tales, songs and surprising sounds. Presented as part of the Festival La Cour des Contes with the Valence Romans Agglo library network, it invites audiences on a sensitive winter journey.
https://armenopole.com/deuxieme-edition-: The second edition of the AYK International Armenian Film Festival, organised by the CNMA, takes place across seven cities in Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. In Lyon, three screenings are scheduled, including the closing ceremony featuring "There Was, There Was Not" with protagonist Siranush Sargsyan in attendance.
https://armenopole.com/lancement-de-la-b: Bookstore Mémoire 7 hosts the launch of graphic novel "Aurora" with filmmaker Inna Sahakyan and writer Arnaud Delalande. Adapted from the animated documentary "Aurora's Sunrise," it depicts Armenian Genocide survivor Aurora Mardiganian's journey. A historically significant event blending testimony and art.
https://armenopole.com/8l4fiiwm.html: An ecumenical ceremony honors King Leon V of Lusignan, the last king of Armenia, at the invitation of Prince Philippe Roux de Lusignan. Archbishop Élie Yeghiayan celebrates a Mass according to the Armenian Catholic rite, joined by Archbishop Étienne Guillet, Rev. René Léonian, and Fr. Jean-Christophe Helbecque. The Sipan-Komitas Choir, directed by Davit Pivazyan, performs, followed by a meditation at the cenotaph featuring duduk, organ, soprano, and bass-baritones.
https://armenopole.com/sacrees-f-ames-de: Lydie Belmonte, surrounded by dancers, delivers a polymorphic performance in twelve tableaux embodying female archetypes from goddess to warrior. This humanist, committed show honours women's resilience through history, dedicated to martyr soldier Anush Apétyan. A poetic hymn to reconciliation, performed for the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women.
https://armenopole.com/christmas-luncheo: Christmas luncheon featuring a buffet, fashion show by Karen Canavan, and special performance by the Nreni Dance Ensemble. Community event with raffle prizes and vendors.
https://armenopole.com/christmas-party-u: The Armenian School hosts a family Christmas party with celebration, lunch, assembly and a visit from Santa. Features gift stalls, a raffle draw and festive fun. Everyone is welcome in a warm, cheerful atmosphere.
https://armenopole.com/6ja6i8q3.html: The Armenian Christmas Eve celebration in Québec features Sako Tashjian and his ensemble for a festive evening of traditional music and dance.
https://armenopole.com/christmas-party-w: A Christmas party featuring singer Ararad Aharonian, backed by Hovsep Karamanougian on keyboards, the Chouljian Band, and Toros Nakkashian on bouzouki.
https://armenopole.com/new-year-s-eve-ce: AGBU Montreal hosts a New Year's Eve celebration to welcome 2027 with fine entertainment, delicious food, and a spectacular festive atmosphere filled with joy and lasting memories.
https://armenopole.com/new-year-after-pa: New Year After Party featuring live performances by Vartan Ghazarian from Sweden and Dikran Hovanessian from Germany. A festive celebration welcoming the new year with Armenian music.
https://armenopole.com/diaspora-en-movim: Marking Diario Armenia's 95th anniversary, the panel “Diáspora en Movimiento” brings together historians, a psychologist, a medical director, a business leader and a cultural association representative to discuss Armenia-Diaspora relations, identity, new generations and institutional roles in Argentina and South America. Pablo Kendikian, Diario Armenia's director, moderates.
https://armenopole.com/hrant-dink-20th-a: The Armenian Missionary Association of Australia (AMAA) and the Armenian National Committee of Australia (ANC-A) jointly host a commemoration evening marking the 20th anniversary of Hrant Dink's assassination. Mrs Rakel Dink is the guest of honour. A cultural performance will honour his legacy of peace, coexistence and understanding.
